question_text: Construct summary(readings) in Python to return(maximum, minimum, arithmetic mean) for a nonempty list of integer measurements. Use explicit comparisons and accumulation; do not use min, max, sum or statistics helpers.
adaptation_rationale: Retains single pass statistics; explicit helper restriction assess algorithm; fix es source example else-if bug and preserves fractional mean.

marking_points.criterion: Initializes low and high from a valid reading.
Updates high when value>high independently of low update.
Returns maximum, minimum, mean in required order.

acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent technically correct wording or valid implementation earning the specified independent points.
partial_credit_notes: Award each stated point independently up to the total; do not double-credit the same idea.

verification.technical: Concrete marking points independently reasoned from the defined context and exact 2027 scope.
verification.code_check: Executable checks saved under checks/ where applicable.
